objective: Map where interaction states (hover, pressed, focus, disabled) are required today in HolyAgent's visual-work instructions and design skills, per model family.
scope: Read-only, in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.3-bump (release/0.3.3 bump head; a writer is busy in another worktree, so read this one).

Planned change: for every interactive element, require a visible hover state where a pointer hovers, a pressed/active state on click or tap, a visible keyboard focus state and a disabled state where it applies, mapped per platform (touch: pressed feedback since no hover; web and desktop: both; terminal UIs: focus and selection marks), and make Worker.visual and Reviewer.visual exercise and capture each state. Reason: GPT-family models often skip hover and pressed states.

Map with paths and line ranges: (a) the requirements tree entries for visual work and the design skills (requirements/skills/*-design, visual-judging, worker-visual and reviewer-visual role requirements) and their R- ids, and what they say about states now (the shared core has 'Every state exists and is captured where reachable: hover or press, focus, disabled, loading, empty, error and long content'); (b) the gpt-6 family copies of the same (skills and the Worker.visual and Reviewer.visual agent text), and gpt-6/guide.md's advice on how to phrase rules for that family (checklists, emphasis, examples); (c) the claude-5.5 and kimi-k3.1 copies of the same; (d) the coverage.ts entries for those ids; (e) whether each design skill's capture checklist names hover and pressed captures, per platform section (web, mobile iOS/Android, desktop Windows/macOS/GNOME, TUI); (f) the build step and the generated dist paths these files compile to.
constraints: Read only; make no edits and no git writes.

criteria.text: Parts a to f each name files and line ranges with source evidence

result:
result: Interaction states (hover, press, focus, disabled) are required only as a one-line "every state" floor in the shared design core. No platform capture checklist names hover or pressed captures, and no family's worker or reviewer visual text mentions them. Read-only; no checks run. Paths below are under `I/` = `/home/user/holyagent-0.3.3-bump/packages/runtime/src/instructions/`.

changed: none
checks: none run (read-only map)
blockers: none
questions: none
notes:
- Requirements tree: `I/requirements/skills/{web,mobile,desktop,tui}-design/SKILL.md` are empty scaffold files (0 lines), so the R-ids for the four platform skills have no text. The only R-id requirement text is `I/requirements/design-core/core.md:1` ("See: R-MATERIAL"), so the "Every state" floor lives only in the family copies.
- `I/gpt-6/guide.md` has no advice on emphasis or examples. Its phrasing advice is O1/O2 (state outcome and boundaries, avoid itineraries, lines 27-28), O11 (ban stock phrases by listing, line 40) and O26 (spacing rules stated as outcomes with reasons, lines 65-67).
- The worker/reviewer design text is identical across families and names the skill file (`I/*/roles/worker-visual/design.md:3`, `I/*/roles/reviewer-visual/design.md:3`). A hover/press rule added to the skills would reach both roles, but the captures text (`I/*/roles/reviewer-visual/captures.md`) and `I/*/roles/worker-visual/method.md` do not name state captures.
